name: Alien
source:
This story is about a guy who has been dreaming of having sex with an alien woman for a very long time. At some point, this dream comes true and the guy finally fucked an alien woman!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2203780]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个讲述某位小伙长久以来一直梦想与外星美女做爱的故事。到了某一刻，他的美梦终于成真，如愿以偿地和一位外星女郎云雨了一番！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2203780]Steam[/url]]
